industry_control: historical_CSRC_category_letter; training-only alphabetic reference category; no current industry substitution
pairing_rule: At each t use the identical company-date intersection for every model. Exclude financial institutions, disclosures or industry unavailable at the t-2 15:00 cutoff, and missing fixed financial fields. No future report backfill, zero imputation or outcome-dependent exclusions.
training_clock_rule: Freeze all coefficients at the first evaluation signal cutoff. Purge nominal training target sessions later than that cutoff, including t-1; no evaluation-day refitting or evaluation-derived scaling.
fitting_rule: Unpenalized linear least squares, sample-standardized on eligible training rows only, explicit intercept; company fixed effects reference uses training-only within-company demeaning. Static financial fields are not fitted alongside company fixed effects because they are absorbed.
prediction_postprocessing: none; negative absolute-return predictions are counted, never silently clipped
limitations: Existing 2019 development dates and the 123-company cohort have been inspected. This is not a new blind validation; the parent cohort was retrospectively selected using January 2020 Q&A activity.
Report availability and industry availability use conservative publication-date proxies. Retrieved PDF bytes and provider adjustment vintage are not certified unchanged historical snapshots.
Money funds are not verified unrestricted cash; reported assets are book assets, not market capitalization; liabilities are not renamed interest-bearing debt.

Company-days share dates and financial values repeat within companies. Session deletions describe sensitivity, not independent observations, p-values or serial-dependence-corrected confidence intervals.
A late-available issuer may have very few training observations; their counts are retained. Industry category controls are coarse and do not fully control 42 detailed divisions or business geography.

This absolute-return diagnostic does not establish stock direction, event causality, participant behavior or calibrated endogenous price dynamics. Every result is retained and economic Agent input remains disabled.
